  (∀ (k : ℕ), k < a k + R) →
    ∀ (c : ℕ → ℝ),
      (∀ (j : ℕ), 0 ≤ c j) →
        ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (K + 1), ∑ j ∈ Finset.Ico (a k) k, c j ≤ ↑R * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (K + 1), c j
